**I am calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain - the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in human, pig, and mouse.**

*Human*
```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_elevated_human)
```

*Pig*
```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_elevated_pig)
```

*Mouse*
```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_elevated_mouse)
```

The highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression was humans, with 430.
